parts.t: Bright & spacious 1-bed 1 bath condo at the Quattro, in Surrey City Centre! Featuring huge windows, 9' ceilings, and a sunny west-facing balcony! The open kitchen boasts granite counters, S/S appliances & modern cabinetry, while the spacious bedroom fits a king-size bed with ample closet space. Located in a well-managed building with a fitness centre & courtyard, just steps to SkyTrain, SFU, Surrey Memorial & top shops/restaurants. Includes parking & storage! PETS ALLOWED!
